maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.detail-2: The creature collapses, its many eyes blinking out one by one.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.detail-4: The cavern opens into a huge underground chamber. Roots crawl down the walls and vanish beneath the green surface.

maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.detail-7: That creature rises from the pool, staring at the lifeless tentacles.

maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue: For a moment, the madness leaves them. Something old and aware looks back at you.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-11: You hurl Grgla's foul gift toward the creature's gaping maw.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-12: The creature snaps it from the air. For a heartbeat, every eye closes.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-14: Its mouths open again, wider than before.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-17: You try speaking to the creature, but it ignores you.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-18: Its eyes shift toward the depths of the pool, as though listening to something below.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-19: The creature recoils, not in fear, but in fury.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-2: "You... do not know... what you have done..."
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-20: It sinks back into the pool, leaving only its eyes above the water.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-22: The water breaks around you. Tendrils rise from the pool, slick with mud and old blood.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-23: The creature rises from the pool, staring at the lifeless tendrils.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-28: The creature trembles. Its grief twists into rage.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-29: The creature staggers. Its jaws quiver.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-3: Then it sinks beneath the water.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-35: Give it Grgla's fish. (With Grgla's Fish)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-37: We can't risk letting you go.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-39: The creature closes several of its eyes.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-4: The cavern opens into a huge underground chamber. Roots crawl down the walls and vanish beneath the green surface.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-41: "The roots came first... then the whispers..."
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-47: Something wet gathers in the corners of too many eyes.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-5: Then the pool opens, and the thing from the marsh is here again.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-52: Without another sound it slips beneath the green water.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-53: Moments later, the pool is without a ripple.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-54: Choose “We can't risk letting you go.”
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-57: Its maw opens wide as it lunges toward you. Perhaps you could throw something into it.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-6: Its eyes find you one by one. Its mouths work in silence before the first word escapes.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-60: Throw Grgla's fish. (Holding Grgla's Fish, can be done only once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-61: Throw a Void Shard. (Possessing a Voidshard, can only be done once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-62: Throw a Poison Potion. (Possess a Poison Potion; can only be used once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-63: Throw a Healing Potion. (Possess Potion of Healing; can only be used once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-66: Throw unknown tincture. (Possess the Unknown Tincture; can be used only once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-67: Throw a Red Mushroom. (Possess the Red Mushroom; can be used only once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-68: Throw an Ironhide Potion. (Possess the Ironhide Potion; can be used only once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-69: Throw a Toast. (Possess the Dungeon Toast; can be used only once.)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-71: You tighten your grip on your weapon.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-73: The creature gulps the mushroom without chewing.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-74: Its countless eyes begin drifting in different directions.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-77: The bottle shatters between its teeth.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-78: Its hide hardens with a dull crack.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-8: We don't want to fight. (once only)
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-89: The fish disappears into its maw.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.dialogue-98: A cloud of foul green vapor bursts from its throat.
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.f08.detail: Step on the sensor at (-15, 0) to trigger the Battle of the Marsh Leader. Progress the dialogue until Tentacles appear.

maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.m01.detail: Who will bring it to their veins?
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.m02.detail: Who will pray to the Winter?
maps.points.swamp_dungeon1.n01.detail: Scarlet roots spread from the walls and the murky water. The things that nourish them are beneath the deeper parts of the marsh. It might be better to destroy them before continuing forward.
